tips.label: a 或 an
tips.text: 單數可數名詞前要有冠詞。第一個音是子音用 a，第一個音是母音用 an；要聽發音，不只看字母。

tips.label: 主詞配 be 動詞
tips.text: I 配 am；he、she、it 與單數名詞配 is；you、we、they 與複數名詞配 are。

tips.label: be 動詞否定句
tips.text: 在 am、is、are 後加 not。is not 可縮寫為 isn't，are not 可縮寫為 aren't，但 am not 不再縮寫。

tips.label: Yes／No 問句
tips.text: 把 be 動詞移到主詞前面，句尾加問號。簡答要用代名詞，例如 Is Amy a nurse? Yes, she is.。

tips.label: 形容詞的位置
tips.text: 形容詞可放在 be 動詞後，也可放在名詞前；放在單數名詞前時別忘了 a 或 an。

tips.label: Who 問句
tips.text: 用 Who + be 動詞 + 主詞? 詢問名字、身分或關係，例如 Who is that man? He's my uncle.。

notes.title: 不定冠詞 a 與 an
notes.rule: a + 子音音素；an + 母音音素
notes.description: 單數可數名詞前通常要加 a 或 an。判斷時要聽下一個字的第一個發音：a teacher、a university、an eraser、an MRT station。

notes.title: 人稱代名詞與 be 動詞
notes.description: be 動詞要隨主詞改變。肯定縮寫有 I'm、you're、he's、she's、it's、we're、they're；否定可用 isn't 或 aren't，但 am not 不可再縮寫。

notes.title: be 動詞直述句
notes.rule: 主詞 + be + 名詞／形容詞；否定時在 be 後加 not
notes.description: 名詞補語若是單數可數名詞，前面要有 a、an、the、指示詞或所有格；專有名詞前通常不加冠詞。形容詞可直接放在 be 動詞後。

notes.title: be 動詞的 Yes／No 問答句
notes.rule: Be + 主詞 + 補語? Yes, 代名詞 + be. / No, 代名詞 + be + not.
notes.description: 把直述句的 be 動詞移到句首就能形成問句。簡答中的人名或名詞要改成代名詞；肯定簡答的主詞和 be 動詞不可縮寫。
examples: Is Gary a student? Yes, he is.
Is Amy a doctor? No, she isn't.
Are you a teacher? Yes, I am.
Is it your pet? No, it isn't.

notes.title: 形容詞的兩種位置
notes.rule: 主詞 + be + 形容詞；a/an + 形容詞 + 單數名詞
notes.description: 形容詞可當主詞補語，也可放在名詞前修飾名詞。兩個形容詞可用 and 連接；三個以上通常用逗號分隔，最後一個前加 and。
examples: My brother is tall and strong.
Ed is smart, polite, and cute.

notes.title: 以 Who 為首的問答句
notes.rule: Who + be + 主詞? 主詞 + be + 名字／關係.
notes.description: Who 可詢問名字、身分或關係。接電話或有人按門鈴時用 Who is this? 或 Who's this?，回答時用 This is... 或 It is...。
examples: Who are you? I'm Tony's son.
Who is that woman? She's my aunt.

quiz.question: My uncle is ___ farmer.
quiz.hint: farmer 的第一個音是子音，且為單數可數名詞，所以用 a。

quiz.question: That is ___ old classroom.
quiz.hint: old 的第一個音是母音，單數名詞 classroom 前用 an。

quiz.question: My parents ___ very nice.
quiz.hint: parents 是複數主詞，因此 be 動詞用 are。

quiz.question: Who ___ that young man?
quiz.hint: that young man 是單數主詞，所以 Who 問句用 is。

quiz.question: I ___ a junior high school student.
quiz.hint: 主詞 I 固定搭配 am。

quiz.question: She is not a doctor. Which contraction is correct?
quiz.hint: she 搭配 is；is not 可縮寫為 isn't。

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about our classroom.
quiz.hint: be 動詞直述句的順序是主詞 + be 動詞 + 形容詞。

quiz.question: Is Tina your cousin? No, ___ isn't.
quiz.hint: 簡答不能直接用人名；Tina 要改成代名詞 she。

quiz.question: This is ___ university.
quiz.hint: university 的開頭發音是子音 /j/，所以用 a。

quiz.question: Ben and I ___ in the same class.
quiz.hint: Ben and I 表示複數的 we，因此搭配 are。

quiz.question: Her husband ___ a cook.
quiz.hint: Her husband 是單數第三人稱，be 動詞用 is。

quiz.question: Choose the correct Yes/No question.
options: A. Your aunt is a nurse?
B. Does your aunt a nurse?
C. Is a nurse your aunt is?
D. Is your aunt a nurse?
quiz.hint: 把直述句的 is 移到主詞 your aunt 前面，形成 Is your aunt...?。

quiz.question: Mr. Wang is ___ English teacher.
quiz.hint: English 的第一個音是母音，所以用 an。

quiz.question: We are not farmers. Which contraction is correct?
quiz.hint: we 搭配 are；are not 可縮寫為 aren't。

quiz.question: The child is ___.
quiz.hint: 形容詞當主詞補語時，直接放在 be 動詞後，不加 a。

quiz.question: Who are you? ___ Tony's son.
quiz.hint: 回答自己的身分用 I am，縮寫為 I'm。

quiz.question: My wife is ___ nurse at this school.
quiz.hint: nurse 的第一個音是子音，單數職業名詞前用 a。

quiz.question: You ___ my new PE teacher.
quiz.hint: 主詞 you 無論單複數都搭配 are。

quiz.question: Is your father a farmer? Yes, ___.
quiz.hint: 肯定簡答用 Yes, he is；主詞與 be 動詞不可縮寫。

quiz.question: Choose the correct negative sentence.
options: A. My aunt not is strict.
B. My aunt is a not strict.
D. My aunt is not strict.
quiz.hint: be 動詞否定句是在 is 後面加 not。

quiz.question: It is ___ eraser.
quiz.hint: eraser 的第一個音是母音，所以用 an。

quiz.question: The news ___ really good.
quiz.hint: news 雖然字尾有 s，但在此是不可數單數概念，搭配 is。

quiz.question: She is a ___ woman.
quiz.hint: 形容詞 beautiful 放在名詞 woman 前修飾它。

quiz.question: Who's that woman? ___ my aunt.
quiz.hint: that woman 用 she 代替，因此回答 She's my aunt。

quiz.question: Amy is ___ MRT worker.
quiz.hint: 字母 M 的發音以母音開頭，所以 MRT 前用 an。

quiz.question: I am not a senior high school student. Which form is correct?
options: A. I amn't a senior high school student.
B. I'm not a senior high school student.
C. I isn't a senior high school student.
D. I aren't a senior high school student.
quiz.hint: am not 不可縮寫成 amn't；可以把 I am 縮寫成 I'm。

quiz.question: Which sentence has the correct adjective order?
options: A. He is boy a handsome.
B. He handsome is a boy.
C. He is a handsome boy.
D. He is handsome a boy.
quiz.hint: 正確順序是 a + 形容詞 handsome + 單數名詞 boy。

quiz.question: Are your cousins at school? No, ___.
quiz.hint: your cousins 是複數，簡答改用 they；否定用 aren't。

quiz.question: This is ___ cute pet.
quiz.hint: cute 的第一個音是子音，所以用 a cute pet。

quiz.question: My daughter and her cousin ___ young.
quiz.hint: 兩個人以 and 連接，主詞是複數，因此用 are。

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence with two adjectives.
options: A. My uncle tall and strong is.
B. My uncle is tall strong and.
C. My uncle is tall and strong.
D. My uncle is and tall strong.
quiz.hint: 兩個形容詞可在 be 動詞後以 and 連接。

quiz.question: Who ___ your parents?
quiz.hint: your parents 是複數主詞，所以 Who 問句搭配 are。

quiz.question: Mr. Lee is ___ honest doctor.
quiz.hint: honest 的 h 不發音，第一個音是母音，因此用 an。

quiz.question: This pet ___ cute, but it is not young.
quiz.hint: This pet 是單數主詞，所以搭配 is。

quiz.question: Is that man your PE teacher? Yes, ___.
quiz.hint: that man 在簡答中改用 he，肯定簡答寫 he is。

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence about Miss Lin.
options: A. She is teacher strict a.
B. She strict is a teacher.
C. She is a strict teacher is.
D. She is a strict teacher.
quiz.hint: 正確順序是主詞 + be 動詞 + a + 形容詞 + 單數名詞。

quiz.question: My mother is ___ office worker.
quiz.hint: office 的第一個音是母音，所以用 an。

quiz.question: They ___ from the same family.
quiz.hint: 主詞 they 固定搭配 are。

quiz.question: Which question correctly asks about the boy's identity?
quiz.hint: 詢問身分用 Who + be 動詞 + 主詞?。

quiz.question: Is the problem big? No, ___.
quiz.hint: the problem 是單數事物，簡答用 it；否定為 it isn't。

quiz.question: Her son is ___ nice young man.
quiz.hint: nice 的第一個音是子音，且 man 是單數可數名詞，所以用 a。

quiz.question: Who is this? ___ Amy.
quiz.hint: 接電話或應門時，Who is this? 可用 This is + 名字回答。

quiz.question: Ed is smart, polite, ___ cute.
quiz.hint: 三個並列形容詞在最後一個形容詞前用 and。

quiz.question: Choose the correct question and short answer.
options: A. Is she a nurse? Yes, she's.
B. She is a nurse? Yes, she is.
C. Is she nurse? Yes, she is a.
D. Is she a nurse? Yes, she is.
quiz.hint: 問句需把 is 提前；肯定簡答寫 Yes, she is，不可縮寫成 she's。

quiz.question: This is ___ big news story.
quiz.hint: big 的第一個音是子音，單數名詞 story 前用 a。

quiz.question: Our classroom and their classroom ___ warm.
quiz.hint: 兩個 classroom 以 and 連接，形成複數主詞，所以用 are。

quiz.question: That girl ___ my daughter; she is my cousin.
quiz.hint: That girl 是單數，否定用 is not，縮寫為 isn't。

quiz.question: Who is that handsome man? ___ our new doctor.
quiz.hint: that handsome man 用 he 代替，所以回答 He's our new doctor。

quiz.question: Kevin is ___ eighteen-year-old student.
quiz.hint: eighteen 的第一個音是母音，因此用 an。

quiz.question: ___ your wife a senior high school teacher?
quiz.hint: your wife 是單數主詞；Yes／No 問句將 is 放到句首。
